READ-BACK: Memory Site (memory-site)

THE PLACE

  Memory Site (memory-site)
    - The site `memory-site` is “Memory Site”, a version 5 site document; its void is transparent, its
        lighting bright and its standing rule centre-covered. [key]
    - The floor is 2 regions with cells: West room (region-west) and East room (region-east). Summarised:
        their cells, lighting and ground are not said one by one. [room.room.regions]
    - Summarised: the coordinate frame, 1 wall line with 1 door in their openings, 0 scene items, 0 prop
        footprints and 0 arrangements. Their positions and shapes are not said one by one. [room.room.walls]
    - The party starts at q 0, r 1, in West room (region-west). [room.room.partyStart]
    - The party's sharing is not set, so it is shared view, the default. [(engine rule)]
    - The door `gate-door` starts closed. [room.room.doorBindings.gate-door]

  Where the places join
    - East room (region-east) and West room (region-west) join at the door `gate-door`. Whether a member may
        cross there is the door's to say: how the door starts, its lock and its holders are said with the door
        `gate-door`. [room.room.doorBindings.gate-door]
      - The fight lifts the holders' bar of the join of East room and West room at the door `gate-door`: Guard
          (g) each hold the door only while posted, up and standing on a cell of the post; one who is down, or
          drawn off the post, holds nothing. Failing it is losing the fight. [room.room.monsterBindings.g
          .posts]

SIDES

  Faction `watch`
    - The faction `watch` is Guard (g); its mind (whose knowledge decides how the side stands) is Guard (g).
        [factions[0]]

  How the sides stand
    - The factions `watch` and `party` start neutral. [dispositions[0]]

CREATURES

  Guard (g): a dnd5e:monsters:guard of `watch` at q 2, r 0 in West room, facing e
      [room.room.monsterDeclarations[0]]
    - Runs the routine `watch` (as `policy`), whose state decides its posts and blocking. [.behaviors[0]]
    - While its routine is in `posted` or `alert`, the guard's body blocks the cell it stands on.
        [.blockingStates]
    - While its routine is in `alert` or `posted` and the guard stands, up, on q 2, r 0, it holds the door
        `gate-door` against anyone not allied with it, one way: from its side (West room) to the far side.
        [.posts.alert, .posts.posted]

ROUTINES

  Routine `watch` — run by Guard (g); starts in `posted`; recipe `site:behaviors:watch`.
      [behaviorDefinitions.watch]
    - Memory (it is the runner):
      - Remembers the flag `warned`, a bool that starts as false. [warned]
    - States (it is the runner):
      - In `posted`, on its time (out of a fight) → acts from its `post` rows. [posted.transitions[0]]
      - In `posted`, when someone walks into it and its body stops them, if its flag `warned` is set → to
          `alert` and acts from its `alarm` rows (“warned once already”). [posted.transitions[1]]
      - In `posted`, when someone walks into it and its body stops them → to `posted`, acts from its `warn`
          rows and sets `warned` to true (“a first warning”). [posted.transitions[2]]
      - In `alert`, on its time (out of a fight) → to `posted`, clears `warned` and acts from its `post` rows
          (“the alarm is raised”). [alert.transitions[0]]
    - Rows (one whose conditions are true is picked by weight):
      - `alarm`: says “Guards! Guards!” [alarm[0]]
      - `post`: says “All quiet.” [post[0]]
      - `warn`: says “Halt.” [warn[0]]

NOT YET SAID
  Nothing: every authored thing above is said or summarised.
